events.label: birth
events.text: Mark Reed Levin is born.

evidence.quote: born September 21 , 1957

events.text: Graduates from Cheltenham High School after three years.

evidence.quote: He graduated from Cheltenham High School after three years in 1974

events.text: Graduates Temple University Ambler, B.A. in Political Science.

evidence.quote: graduated magna cum laude and Phi Beta Kappa with a B.A . in Political Science in 1977

events.text: Elected to Cheltenham school board on property-tax platform.

evidence.quote: Later in 1977 , Levin
won election to the Cheltenham school board on a platform of reducing property taxes

events.text: Earns J.D. from Temple University School of Law.

evidence.quote: In 1980 , Levin earned a J.D . from Temple University School of Law

events.text: Begins working in the Reagan administration.

evidence.quote: Beginning in 1981 , Levin worked in the administration of President Ronald Reagan

events.text: Joins Landmark Legal Foundation, a public interest law firm.

evidence.quote: In 1991 , Levin joined public interest law firm Landmark Legal Foundation

events.text: Becomes president of Landmark Legal Foundation.

evidence.quote: before becoming president in 1997

events.label: health
events.text: Suffers heart attack and undergoes open heart surgery.

evidence.quote: Levin suffered a heart attack in 2000

events.label: award
events.text: Receives Ronald Reagan Award from American Conservative Union.

evidence.quote: In 2001 the American Conservative Union awarded Levin its Ronald Reagan Award

events.text: Begins Sunday radio show on WABC.

evidence.quote: initially on Sundays beginning in 2002

events.text: Moves to timeslot following Hannity's program on WABC.

evidence.quote: then in the timeslot following Hannitys program in 2003

events.text: Publishes Men In Black: How The Supreme Court Is Destroying America.

evidence.quote: Levin wrote the 2005 book Men In Black

events.text: Cumulus Media begins national syndication of The Mark Levin Show.

evidence.quote: Cumulus Media Networks began syndicating The Mark Levin Show nationally

events.text: Publishes non-fiction book about rescuing dog Sprite (title not in source).

evidence.quote: written by Levin in 2007

events.text: Publishes Liberty and Tyranny: A Conservative Manifesto.

evidence.quote: Liberty and Tyranny : A Conservative Manifesto was released in 2009

events.text: Show begins paid sponsorship deal with Americans for Prosperity.

evidence.quote: a deal which began in the summer of 2010

events.text: Publishes Ameritopia: The Unmaking of America.

evidence.quote: Ameritopia : The Unmaking of America was issued in 2012

events.text: Publishes 2013 book proposing eleven new constitutional amendments.

evidence.quote: In Levins 2013 book he suggests eleven new Constitutional amendments

events.text: Becomes founding editor-in-chief of Conservative Review.

evidence.quote: Since 2014 , Levin has been the founding editor-in-chief of Conservative Review

events.text: Becomes editor-in-chief of Conservative Review.

evidence.quote: Since 2015 , Levin has been editor-in-chief of the Conservative Review

events.text: Publishes Plunder and Deceit: Big Government's Exploitation of Young People.

evidence.quote: Plunder and Deceit : Big Governments Exploitation of Young People and the Future was published in 2015

events.text: Signs ten-year contract extension with Westwood One.

evidence.quote: On February 11 , 2016 , Levin signed a ten-year contract extension with Westwood One

events.text: Publishes Rediscovering Americanism and the Tyranny of Progressivism.

evidence.quote: Rediscovering Americanism and the Tyranny of Progressivism in 2017

events.text: Fox News announces signing of Levin for weekend show.

evidence.quote: In November 2017 , Fox News announced that it had signed Levin for a weekend show

events.text: Steps down as president of Landmark Legal, remains on its board.

evidence.quote: In 2018 , Levin stepped down as president of Landmark Legal

events.label: honour
events.text: Inducted into the National Radio Hall of Fame.

evidence.quote: On November 16 , 2018 , he was inducted to the National Radio Hall of Fame

events.text: Publishes Unfreedom of the Press.

evidence.quote: Unfreedom of the Press , which was released on May 21 , 2019
